🗣️🎙️ @MYAPLANET9 will be on The Breakfast Club tomorrow discussing her  10th Studio Album 💿 “Retrospect” out on May 15th!
Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

🚨Donkey of the Day goes to a Florida man who was arrested for assaulting a 5-year-old boy after assuming the child was givin' “gay ” because of his mannerisms and tried to beat the gay out of him.🫣Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC

Video

🚨 Stefon Diggs found not guilty in his assault trial involving his former in-house chef. @lorenlorosa has the latest, tap in for the full breakdown!

Video

🚨 @UpsetTheX  opens up about the importance of acknowledging family curses in order to break generational curses and the realization of the peace he found after speaking his truth after being SA'd. Check out the full conversation in @netflix

Video

🗣️🎙️ @MichaelJaiWhite  came through to promote his new film 'Special Op: Rent-a-Cop', and did you know he does his own martial arts stunts 🤯? Michael dives into what learning martial arts has done to his ego and how a big ego can lead to unhappiness. Check out the full conversation on @netflix.

Video

🚨The Met Gala conversation continues, Jenifer Lewis speaks out on her sentiments about the celebrities who showed up, stating, “How much fame do we need?” Tap into the full latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video

📕 @upsetthegram Tim Ross came through to promote his new book 'The Missing Peace', which helps break down how one can hold it together while falling apart and how not to fall for the temporary dopamine hits of life! Check out the full interview on @netflix

Video

🚨 @complex has dropped their 35 most impactful voices in hip-hop media, and congratulations are in order as @cthagod & @lorenlorosa have made the list 🎉! Tap in as @lorenlorosa has the latest!

Video

🗣️🎙️ @MichaelJaiWhite  will be on The Breakfast Club tomorrow discussing his new film 'Special Op: Rent-a-Cop'
Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ⏰ ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

🗣️🎙️ Tim Ross @upsetthegram will be on The Breakfast Club tomorrow discussing his new book 📕 'Upset The World.' 
Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ⏰ ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

🚨 @shantidas404’s mission and goal is to @silencetheshame the negative stigma people have around mental health. Shanti details a moment when the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline saved her life and expresses how important it is to get help!  Tap into the full conversation on @netflix ➡️ to help the cause head to silencetheshame.com or text “Silence” to 707070.

Video

🚨 Donkey of the Day goes to the man who hit a customer with his Nissan Altima for not leaving a tip after delivering their food! What if that person couldn’t afford to? 👀
Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC

Video

🚨 @zurihall opens up about how she was able to use moments of being underutilized earlier in her career and turn them into experiences that shaped her into who she is today. Check out the full interview on @netflix

Video

🚨 TODAY is @silencetheshame Day, and as @shantidas404 continues fighting the good fight to help people improve and learn about their mental health, the loss of $600K in state funding heavily impacts a nonprofit like this. Listen in to hear how this organization is saving lives on @netflix. Tap in to help ➡️ silencetheshame.com or text “Silence” to 707070.

Video

🚨 @zurihall has covered the Met Gala for years and breaks down the exclusivity of the red carpet, the protests of the night, and why it’s often hard to get celebrities to stop for interviews. Tap in for the full first hand breakdown RN on @netflix !

Video

🚨 @isaiahrashad breaks down some of his tracks on 'It's Been Awful' and opens up on what in his life has inspired certain records off the album. He explains how he handles his addictions, identifying his masculinity and more! Check out the full interview on @netflix

Video

🚨 The Met Gala was last night, and Beyoncé hit the red carpet for the first time in 10 years, along with many other big names! The conversation continues as Taraji P. Henson called out the celebrities who participated in this year’s gala due to Jeff Bezos’ involvement. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video

🚨 @isaiahrashad came through to promote his new album 💿 'It’s Been Awful' and explains how he’s been on a journey of reconstructing his sexuality. After the release segg tape, that moment forced him to reflect on his actions and allow him to live more in his purpose. Check out the full conversation on @netflix.

Video

🗣️🎙️ Tomorrow is @silencetheshame Day with @ShantiDas404, and she will be on The Breakfast Club discussing and dispelling the negative stigma surrounding mental health and why it’s important to understand for your overall wellness!
Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ⏰ ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…
